questions.q: What are the exact dimensions (diameter and length, including stem) of the Small and Large cups?
questions.why: Size specs help readers confirm fit and compare against other brands, which the current data lacks.

questions.q: Does the instruction manual specify how often to replace the cup, and any signs (cracks, odour, discolouration) that mean it should be replaced sooner?
questions.why: The 5–10 year lifespan claim needs concrete replacement triggers for a credible cleaning/care article.

questions.q: What exactly is included in the box (cup, pouch, manual, anything else)?
questions.why: Confirms what buyers receive, useful for a 'what's in the pack' section.

questions.q: Does the manual give guidance on how to sterilise without a pot (e.g. microwave, sterilising tablets, cup steamer)?
questions.why: Boiling is covered, but readers often ask about alternative sterilising methods.

questions.q: Are there any stated limits on soap or cleaning products to avoid (e.g. oil-based, fragranced, antibacterial), and any warnings about harsh cleaners?
questions.why: Adds concrete 'what not to use' facts that strengthen the cleaning guidance.
